generation_provenance.mapping_policy: Mapping manifests define intended solution/source links; fetched source data takes precedence for source-dependent facts.
generation_provenance.null_policy: Unavailable or scope-incompatible source-dependent values remain null and include a status instead of being inferred from neighbouring variants.
generation_provenance.economic_scope_policy: A CYPE price is stored as the generic solution unit_cost only when the mapped CYPE unit substantially matches the defined GenericSolution scope. Otherwise it is kept as a source_observation.
generation_provenance.environmental_policy: GWP A1-A3 is populated only when the mapped source explicitly provides an assembly-level value.
notes: FAC-PLG-001 in the mapping is normalized to FAC-LGT-001 because the archetype is FAC-LGT and the remaining five solution codes use FAC-LGT.
FLY400 exact mapped URL currently resolves to a 60 mm exterior XPS core, not the 80 mm stated in the mapping. Source data takes precedence.
CYPE does not provide assembly GWP A1-A3 on the mapped pages.
For CTE-only F10.1/F15.1 solutions, CTE reference acoustic/mass/waterproofing data are populated, but U remains unresolved where insulation R is not sourced.

poc_synthetic_completion.policy_override: At the user request, unresolved/null values were completed with coherent synthetic estimates. Original source-dependent claims remain distinguishable through statuses and data_quality_notes.
poc_synthetic_completion.ifc_note: Referenced IFC files in this demo bundle are minimal synthetic IFC4 placeholders, not design BIM models.
